name: Thanatek's Tithe
inspire: Once per turn, in your Power step, instead of playing a Power card, you can pick a friendly fighter and remove a number of your cadaver tokens equal to their Bounty characteristic. Inspire that fighter.

reactions.name: Morbid Retainers
reactions.rulesText: Immediately after a friendly fighter's successful Attack, if the target is adjacent to any friendly Retainers ({icon:retainer}), gain 1 cadaver token.

reactions.name: Soul-linked Constructs
reactions.rulesText: Your leader's ({icon:leader}) weapons' characteristics cannot be modified. When you pick a target as part of your leader's ({icon:leader}) Attack using a non-Upgrade melee weapon, you can measure the range of that weapon from a friendly Retainer ({icon:retainer}) instead of from your leader ({icon:leader}).

reactions.name: Elusive Mirages
reactions.rulesText: Immediately after an enemy fighter's successful Attack that targeted a friendly Mortis Reaper ({icon:mortis-reaper}), if the Save roll contained any successes, that friendly fighter can use Stand Fast.

abilities.name: Unwilling Donors
abilities.trigger: Use this at the start of your opponent's Action step if your leader ({icon:leader}) is on the battlefield.
abilities.flavorText: The living will sacrifice their bones unto the great Ossiarch empire, whether willingly or otherwise.
abilities.rulesText: Pick an enemy fighter to be the possessor until the end of your next turn. Immediately after damage is inflicted on the possessor as part of a friendly fighter's Attack, you can push each friendly Retainer ({icon:retainer}) 1 hex closer to the possessor.

abilities.name: Endless Duty
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Even the destruction of their physical form does not release a Bonereaper from their eternal service to Nagash.
abilities.rulesText: Remove any of your cadaver tokens. Pick a slain friendly Mortis Reaper ({icon:mortis-reaper}), then roll an Attack dice for each cadaver token you removed. If the roll contains any {icon:hammer} or {icon:crit}, Raise that fighter and place them in a starting hex in friendly territory. You can only use this ability once per battle round.

abilities.name: Necromantic Pulse
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Thanatek channels deathly energy into a crushing wave to drive his enemies back.
abilities.rulesText: Remove any of your cadaver tokens. For each enemy fighter adjacent to any friendly Retainers ({icon:retainer}), roll a number of Attack dice equal to the number of cadaver tokens you removed. If the roll contains any {icon:swords} or {icon:crit}, inflict 1 damage on that enemy fighter. Otherwise, remove that enemy fighter's Guard tokens and give them a Stagger token. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Five Ossiarch Bonereapers built around a durable flying leader and two sturdy Retainers, backed by fast but fragile dodging Mortis Reapers. Attacks landed next to Retainers generate cadaver tokens, which fuel Inspiring, raising slain Reapers and a once-per-game necromantic pulse that damages or staggers adjacent enemies. Thanatek can strike through his Retainers, who get pushed toward wounded targets. The warband wins by pinning enemies against its Retainers, farming cadavers and recycling expendable Reapers to grind foes down.
